CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

2. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

6. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 14
   D. 9

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 21

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 16
   D. 7

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 12

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

13. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

17. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

18. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

19. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

22. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

23. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11
